The signed area of a polygon can be computed using the shoelace formula or by summing the signed areas of triangles formed by a fixed point (the first vertex) and each edge of the polygon.

The signed area of a triangle formed by points $P_0, P_i, P_{i+1}$ is given by:
$\text{Area} = \frac{1}{2} ((x_i - x_0)(y_{i+1} - y_0) - (x_{i+1} - x_0)(y_i - y_0))$

The total signed area of the polygon is the sum of these triangle areas for $i = 1$ to $n-2$.
